findings.must_convey: The subscription update commits in RenewalRepository.renew before BillingOutbox.append executes as a separate database operation, so a failure between them leaves changed business state with no durable event. Make the business write and outbox insert one atomic repository/unit-of-work operation.

claimBatch sets publishedAt before dispatchBillingEvents calls the external publisher. If publishing fails, the event is already excluded from future pending batches and is lost. Claim with a lease/in-progress state and mark published only after successful delivery.

handleSubscriptionRenewed increments account credits without recording or checking event.id. A redelivery can apply the credit bonus more than once; persist a deduplication key or otherwise make event handling idempotent.
